title: Fenwick Range Sums
statement:
Implement a Fenwick tree for point additions and inclusive range sums.

Input
n q, the n initial values, then q operations. ADD i x adds x to the 1-based index i. SUM L R queries 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ n.

Output
Print the answer to each SUM in input order.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000. Initial values and x have absolute value at most 10⁹.
